topic: Chile is a thin ribbon country
hook: Your map of Chile shows a country shaped like a ribbon.
title: Your Map of Chile Is a Ribbon Country
description:
Chile stretches about 4,300 km from north to south but is only about 177 km wide on average. The Andes and the Pacific squeeze it into a thin strip. Part of the Places That Shouldn't Exist series.

#Shorts #Chile #Geography
